context_requirements: Cells must be actively dividing so that DNMT1 inhibition can affect DNA methylation maintenance and cell-cycle progression.
DNMT1 expression and dependency; lines with low DNMT1 or redundant DNMT3A/3B may show little response.
Intact p53/RB pathways may be needed for robust CDKN1A/GADD45 induction and cell-cycle arrest.
Sufficient exposure duration (24 h) for transcriptional consequences of epigenetic and cell-cycle perturbation.
falsifiers: No change in DNMT1, DNMT3A, CDKN1A, CDKN1B, GADD45A, or GADD45B at 24 h in any line.
No decrease in proliferation/cell-cycle genes (e.g., CCNA2, CCNB1, CDK1, MCM3, PCNA) at 24 h.
Strong and consistent upregulation of cholesterol biosynthesis genes (HMGCR, HMGCS1, FDFT1, SQLE, EBP, NSDHL) across lines, which would suggest a different antifungal mechanism.
Clear transcriptional response at 6 h, contradicting the expected slow kinetics.
